items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: Cello player -- Ben Webster went there and stayed.

ctx.x: He was obviously a great guy to work for.

Oh, he was a great guy, great guy. I love him, love him. He's like my father -- he taught me so much coming up. He's a little older than I am -- as I say, he's 82. And we finally left Denmark -- but I'm telling you, I've since then wanted to back to Denmark. I know a lot of guys go to Denmark and stay. What's the cello player -- the bass player that went there and stayed? Cello player -- Ben Webster went there and stayed. A lot of guys go there and stay and just live because Denmark is just one of the finest…
Now, you've told us about some of the happy experiences during your tour in Europe. Did you ever run into any more unfortunate experiences while in Europe?
